correctness.rationale: Every event v_p(F_i)=1 is determined modulo p². Primitive root lines counted as 2(p−1) per square slope; Hensel linearization gives p allowed lifts if all parameters agree mod p², otherwise zero, yielding exact conditional count over p⁴−p² primitive pairs. For s slopes at most k−s can be made incoherent, hence h≥max(0,2s−k); s−max(0,2s−k)/p strictly increases for odd p, giving exact minimizer and equality conditions. Direct independent enumeration verified 553 configurations with p in {3,5,7,11}, k≤7. Finite checks alone do not prove universal theorem.

value.rationale: This natural simultaneous-squarefulness local condition is the p-adic factor relevant to multi-divisor Campana restrictions. The theorem gives the full k-dependent sharp local-density spectrum, all equality cases, and a universal positive saturation level 2/(p+1). It exposes a genuine mod-p versus mod-p² transition invisible to individual local factors, with direct use in evaluating or bounding future joint local constants. It makes no unsupported global asymptotic claim.
